summary: This bill requires the Department of Defense to establish procedures for Members of Congress and their accompanying staff to gain expedited access to certain military installations in the U.S. and Guam by simply presenting their Congressional identification, without prior scheduling.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends Title 10 of the U.S. Code, which pertains to the armed forces, by establishing procedures for Congressional access to military installations. While it deals with military facilities, it does not directly address military spending or defense budgets, focusing instead on access protocols.
